notes.title: Ladra v.1.4 is out!
notes.content:
Hey guys and gals! Ladra v.1.4 is out now for all your stealth delights. 

Aside from a bunch of fixes the main focus of this new version is the addition of the much requested chapter selector.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10623731/79e8cfe66392a592aafe10f08f53599c3e4a09d5.gif[/img]

You can check what you've missed on each episode and replay them to get those desired achivements to pop out :) 

Also, remember to follow Is Future Bright on [url=twitter.com/isfuturebright]Twitter[/url],  [url=facebook.com/isfuturebright]Facebook[/url] and [url=tumblr.isfuturebright.com]Tumblr[/url] so you can keep up with the new project coming up!

[h1] Ladra v.1.4 - Changelog:[/h1]

[b]New:[/b]
- Chapter select screen added
- Achievement texts scroll faster
- Made "grab the treasure" tutorial text vanish right after you get the treasure and not when leaving the room.
- Changed "book" asset to one that calls out more attention so players stop investigating every possible shelf.
- Made changes to final maps on chapter 4. Reworked the tunel and the guard placement.

[b]Fix:[/b]
- [Valoruke] Fixed issue where message didn't display in balloon format when talking with Zahs on the Valoruke
- [Valoruke] Fixed issue where Tonan would display wrong option for conversation.
- [Ch4] Fixed issue where player could go up mountains if there was a prop on the edges.
- [Ch2-4] Fixed issues where guards would get stuck.
- [Ch4] Going back from the last map and re-entering again would make the screen turn black and stay there.
- Fixed issue where opening same chest multiple times would unlock achievement.
- Fixed issue where stealing books would break the counter
- Fixed issue where treasure counter on the pause menu would show 10/1
- [Ch3] Fixed issue where the boat displayed the wrong message

notes.title: Ladra v.1.3 is out!
notes.content:
After two weeks having issues I was finally able to get the version through to steam! Behold! It's live!! 

Ladra v.1.3 - Changelog:

New:
- Treasure and book tracker on the Pause Menu
- Achievements support
- Achievements menu inside the game 

Fix:
- Misspelled texts entries
- Dog tutorial not showing properly
- Fixed issue where time on a mission wasn’t working
- Fixed issue where total detections always showed as 0 sometimes 
- Better gameplay and overall flow of the game

notes.title: Ladra v.1.2.1 released
notes.content:
New:
- French language added
- Russian language added

Fix:
- (EN) "nil" text when talking with Tonan in the Valoruke now shows the correct value "Skip cutscene?"
- (EN) Removed space after the apostrophes that looked like acute accents.

A big shout out to the translators Maureen Blanchard and Andrew Krepyshev for getting all done so fast! 

Next update will include dutch as available language and hopefully Steam cards! \o

If you wanna help out on the translation as well, give me a shout. Thanks!

notes.title: Update - Ladra v.1.1 Incoming
notes.content:
Ladra update cheduled for 12/21 .:.

New:
- Cloud Save Support
- Partial Controller Support (Press F1) 
- Pause menu to quit the game (No more Alt+F4 :P)
- Multilang support added. More languages on the next update

Fix:
- Text review
- Slicker Splash Screen and Menu

The game is currently being translated to Portuguese and Spanish. If you would like to work on the translation for any other language just message me or email (contact@isfuturebright.com) :)
